item.title: Trump's CDC director ordered delay in counting Pennsylvania measles deaths
item.description: In a highly unusual move, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has declined to count two measles-associated deaths reported by Pennsylvania in its national tally, acting on an order from new CDC Director Dr. Erica Schwartz, according to two people with knowledge of the decision. item.title: UniQure files for FDA approval of first gene therapy for Huntington's disease
item.description: UniQure has submitted a biologics license application (BLA) to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for AMT-130, its gene therapy for Huntington’s disease, and has also applied for approval in the United Kingdom.
